{{Quote|Do you know why Emberlene died, Shada? Not ''how'' it died—not the firestorming and massive air and space attack that finally crushed it&mdash;but ''why?''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''Someone feared our growing power and prestige and decided to make an example of us. Some think that person was Palpatine himself, which is why we've never worked for his Empire.''"<br />"''Never?''"<br />"''We had millions of refugees to feed and clothe. Yes, sometimes we worked even for the Empire.''"<br />"''Principles are so often like that, aren't they? So very slippery. So hard to hold on to. At any rate, that particular principle was of no real value. As it happens, Palpatine had nothing to do with Emberlene's destruction.|[[Jorj Car'das]] and [[Shada D'ukal]]|<ref name="VotF" />}}
The '''destruction of Emberlene''' was the event that ruined the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Emberlene]], a planet where the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard|Mistryl]] lived. [[Jorj Car'das]] obtained the information on the destruction and offered it to Mistryl [[Shada D'ukal]], but she instead chose information that helped end the [[Battle of Yaga Minor]] at the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
